glosses: to repeat
passive of повторя́ть (povtorjátʹ)
повторять что-то уже ранее сказанное или сделанное; возвращаться к прежним мыслям, темам и т.п.

examples.text: Он мог сочинять и говорить целый день и никогда не повторялся.

glosses: вновь происходить, возникать, появляться

examples.text: Проблемы, возникающие на переговорах, начинают всё чаще повторяться.

glosses: воссоздаваться, воспроизводиться

examples.text: В критике Белинского как бы повторилась вся история русской литературы.

glosses: страд. к повторять

examples.text: Ломоносовские и державинские оды восхвалялись и повторялись только людьми, нечуждыми придворной жизни.

glosses: Of an event, situation, etc.: to appear or happen again, especially repeatedly.
Of a disease or symptom: to happen again, especially repeatedly or after a remission or an apparent recovery.

examples.text: The bullet had grazed the optic nerve. […] The oculist had warned him that the trouble might recur, that he ought to have remained under observation. Well, it had recurred about four months ago.

glosses: Of a memory, thought, etc.: to come to the mind again.

Often in the form recurring following a number: of a numeral or group of numerals in a decimal fraction: to repeat indefinitely.

examples.text: One-third can be written in decimal form as 0.3333 …, or point three-recurring.

CIRCULATING Decimals, or Recurring Decimals, are those that consist of a repetition of a small number of digits, as 646464, &c. 4127127127, &c.; in fact, every decimal that is not finite, is a circulating decimal, or is such, that if continued far enough, the same figures will again recur; but it is only those, of which the periods of circulation consist of a few figures, that receive generally the definition of circulating decimals.

glosses: Followed by from: to move or run back from something; to recede, to withdraw.
